data.credibility: Management guides inconsistently, dropping specific store targets like Tanishq and beYon without explanation while hitting or beating others such as Eyewear growth, making their medium-term commitments moderately reliable.

lines.line: Targeted 35 to 40 Tanishq stores, but management dropped the topic entirely.
Promised 13% to 14% eyewear growth, but actually delivered 44.9% in FY26.
Targeted 15% to 20% jewellery growth over 3 to 5 years, tracking at 19.1%.
Targeted 10 to 12 beYon stores, but dropped the topic in subsequent quarters.

bull: Jewellery revenue growth is on track at 19.1%, aligning with the guided 15% to 20% long-term target range.
Eyewear significantly outperformed its 13% to 14% guidance, hitting 44.9% growth in FY26.
Strong historical compounding with 5-year revenue growth at 32.3% and net profit growth at 39.1% annually.
bear: Borrowings jumped to ₹27,638 cr against net worth of ₹18,263 cr, driving a heavily geared debt-to-equity ratio of 1.51.
Operating cash flow is weak, representing just 43% of reported profit over 5 years with negative cash flows in FY22 and FY25.
Management frequently drops specific guidance topics like Tanishq and beYon store expansion targets across subsequent quarters.
